added_lines: prayer for families jesus, lord and saviour, you have shown us your love in your care for all, especially those in need. we ask you to show this love for our family, those sick and well, at home and away. may we live in your heart, young and old in our family, as we make your home in the heart of each of us. make strong our faith in you and in each other. enliven our hope and make us joyful in love. protect us all and welcome home those who have gone before us. we pray this, in gratitude for our family life, and with the prayers of mary, our mother. amen. tarbert active retirement – (over 55’s) meet in tarbert bridewell every friday between 10.30 am and 12 noon. we have different activities every week followed by refreshments. new members are welcome. clothes collection – the shannonside women’s group will hold a clothes collection in church car park on friday 30th oct. from 8am until 10.30am. bags can also be dropped off at the tarbert community centre on thursday 29th oct. from 6pm to 7pm. the proceeds are going to kerry hospice / palliative care and health lin k / transport. tarbert - are now accepting enrolments for september 2027. if you wish to enrol a child who wil l be four on or before august 31st 2027, a copy of the school’s annual admission notice, admission policy and the application form for admission for 2027 - 2028 are available to download at: log or on request by emailing

or by writing to: tarbert chapel st., tarbert, lis towel, co. kerry. v31 tw13. completed forms must to be returned by 16th november 2026. youth ministry in the diocese of kerry - the diocesan springs of hope newsletter is now available to view. the newsletter provides a colourful and interesting look at some of the exciting things hap pening within the diocese of kerry in the area of youth ministry and the people involved. so, grab a cuppa and have a read! can access this by going directly to

and we’ll get back to you. parish of tuosist newsletter 25th october 2026 30th sunday of ordinary time mass for all those who have died during the year since 1st november 2025 will be celebrated at 10 a.m. on sunday 15th november in lauragh church. there will be a candle on the altar for each person who has died in the parish or elsewhere. please drop in names to ina o’shea in lauragh church, and spread the word to families living away, as we pray for those who died, and for those who are grieving. annual november mass for all those who have died within the hospital over the past year, including in palliative care services, maternity services, the relatives of hospital staff, and former staff members of university hospital kerry. the mass for the dead will be celebrated on monday 2nd november 7pm in st john’s church, castle street, tralee. it will also be live streamed for those unable to attend in person on

remembering our loved ones we always remember our loved ones gone before us, but especially in november. you might like to return your own november list with the mass offering in a november envelope - these are in your box of parish envelopes, and there should be spare envelopes at the newsletter table. if not, you are welcome to return the names in a normal page and envelope marked'tuosist parish'. we will pray for them in all our masses in november, beginning on all souls day sun nov 1st at 10am mass in lauragh. may they rest in peace first saturdays conference in knock – saturday, 28th november, sharing our lady’s messages of fatima and praying together for peace in the world. speakers include fr jamie twohig, fr leon (medjugorje), fr philip kemmy, fr john keane and others. holy mass at 3pm, confession and adoration. coach fare approximately €40 per person, departing caherciveen and stopping at glenbeigh, milltown, castlemaine, farranfore, abbeyfeale and newcastle west. local lift-sharing may be available. for further details, contact siobhan

. everyone is most welcome. october memory cafe – on tuesday 27th october 2026 from 11.00am - 12.30pm at the lansdowne hotel kenmare . this month’s guest speaker is pharmacist angela brosnan from vital pharmacy (brosnans) kenmare, speaking about tips for staying well through cold & flu season and more . recovery haven : free 6-week online course: building better caregivers starts monday, 2nd november from 10:30am – 1:00pm for more information, call

fitness classes in tuosist parish hall: women’s class : mondays @7.30 p.m. men’s class: mondays 8.30 p.m. sign up for 4 weeks at a time. all fitness levels welcome – getfit, feel great! cost: adults: €40 for 4 weeks; under 18s : €20 for 4 weeks to book your place contact fionán on
pilates classes in tuosist parish hall: tuesday 7pm power pilates; 8pm reset pilates 8-week block of classes: cost: 80 euro for 8 weeks. starting tuesday 6th october to book contact fiona healy on

the board of management and school community of lauragh national school have received permission to explore the possibility of becoming a gaelscoil. if you wish to express your viewpoint on the proposal, please write to or contact the school principal or parish priest /moderator of the parish. thank you. the caha centre lauragh community centre – thursdays at 2pm – move well live well - easy fitness for older people. build strength, mobility and balance with chair- based routines and enjoy a cup of tea and chat with the class before you go home. €10 drop in per week samhain event and coffee morning after mass in lauragh community centre on sunday 25 october with guest poet and artist who will create an opportunity for you to share old samhain traditions including ghostly tales, folklore and tales of times gone by. all welcome low-cost counselling, family support, sas alarms and help with form-filling available . contact kathryn, caha centre on
